newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted on Thursday on the St Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded versus no trades Wednesday. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, Illinois (Hennepin), this week, offered at 140 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
- One barge, mid-Mississippi, next week, bid at 150 percent, no offer or comparison.
- One barge, mid-Mississippi, week of March 30, bid five points higher at 150 percent, offered at 155 percent.
- Eight barges, upper Mississippi (St. Paul through Savage), two each week May, bid at 150 percent, no offer or comparison.
